basic_details.short_information: Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai, Indian Railways, will re-engage one retired Railway Gazetted Officer as Consultant (Engg.)/PU/ICF on contract against one vacant Group-B post in its Civil Engineering Department. Only officers retired from Railway services in Group-B (Level-8 & Level-9) of the Civil Engineering Department may apply. The filled application must reach the Personnel Branch, ICF, Chennai-38 on or before 7 December 2026 (Monday) at 17.30 Hrs, by post or by hand.

important_instructions: An application will be treated as "Invalid / Ineligible" if it is unsigned, has no latest photograph affixed, is incomplete, or lacks the copies indicated in Annexure-D. The period of re-engagement shall be up to 31 December 2026; no retired officer should be engaged beyond that date. Re-engagement as Consultant shall not be considered re-employment, and services can be terminated at any time. The re-engaged officer will be discharged immediately on joining of selected candidate(s) from UPSC or through departmental selection, or for any other reasons of administrative convenience on the recommendation of the PHOD/CHOD concerned. content_sections.heading: About ICF Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Integral Coach Factory is a production unit of Indian Railways located in Chennai. This re-engagement is issued by the Office of the PCPO under Railway Board's letters No.2024/E(GR)I/38/I dated 29.08.2024 and 08.11.2024. The notice states that the scheme for re-engagement of retired Railway Gazetted Officers is valid only up to 31 December 2026, and the post is filled "in exigencies of the services".

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the filled application in the prescribed format by post to: Deputy Chief Personnel Officer, Shell Administrative Office, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai – 600 038. Applicants may also submit the application at the Receipt Section of Personnel Branch/ICF. Use the prescribed Application/Proforma given at Annexure-D of the notification. All columns are mandatory, and officers must fill them in their own handwriting. Affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided on the form. Sign legibly in the space provided. Enclose a copy of the PPO (7th CPC Pay Matrix). Superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR RE-ENGAGEMENT AS CONSULTANT (ENGG) / PU / ICF". Send it by post to the address above, or hand it in at the Receipt Section of Personnel Branch/ICF, so that it reaches Personnel Branch/ICF/Chennai-38 on or before 07.12.2026 at 17.30 Hrs. The form asks for the applicant's name, father's name, designation on the day of retirement, date of promotion to Group-B, office from where retired, department, date of birth, age as on the date of notification, Employee No. and HRMS ID, date of appointment, date of retirement, community (SC/ST/OBC/UR), educational/professional qualification, last pay drawn and level, PPO number and date, Basic Pension sanctioned (without deducting commutation pension), permanent and correspondence addresses with PIN code, email ID and mobile number. The applicant also signs declarations on confidentiality, on immediate discharge, and on the truth of the information given. For enquiries, the notice gives these Railway landline numbers: Dy.CPO 044 - 261 47702 and Ch.OS / GAZ 044 - 261 47710.

content_sections.heading: ICF Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Under the Terms of Reference (Annexure-C), the officer will be designated Consultant (Engineering/Construction) or Senior Consultant (Engineering/Construction) and will look after all works connected with maintenance and construction. The work includes responsibilities of inspection, supervision, drawing, etc., excluding Financial and D&AR powers. Inspection of all buildings & structures and their maintenance in a satisfactory and safe condition. Providing suggestion and recommendation for execution and maintenance of works. Verification of stores held by stock-holders. Inspection of Water Supply, and of the Sewerage and Drainage System, and their maintenance in a satisfactory and safe condition. Association with committees and groups such as the Colony Committee, the Sanitation Committee and the Station Improvement Group, with prompt action on items in his jurisdiction. Planning, preparation of plan, execution, measurements, test checking and commissioning of works entrusted to him. The Consultant (Engineering/Construction) will work under the Deputy Chief Engineer; the Senior Consultant (Engineering/Construction) will work under the Administrative Control of the Deputy Chief Engineer. No financial powers to pass bills; they can certify measurement and put up to the Deputy Chief Engineer. No D&AR powers; they can submit recommendations for D&AR actions to the Deputy Chief Engineer. Not authorised to issue safety certificates; they can recommend the issue to the Deputy Chief Engineer. Not to be made in-charge of a unit like Branch Officer in the Division; may recommend suggestions on financial and other matters to the regular officer.

content_sections.text: Filled and signed Application/Proforma (Annexure-D). Recent passport size photograph affixed on the application. Copy of PPO (7th CPC Pay Matrix).

content_sections.text: The suitability/competency of the retired officer will be judged on the basis of the last five APARs, as per established norms for a DPC, by a three-member committee of PHODs/CHODs appointed by the General Manager. While re-engaging the officer, medical fitness in the appropriate category will be obtained from the designated authorities as per existing practices.
